name: Viking® Veil Series 30" Panel Ready Left Hinge Built-In Wine Column
shortDescription: Experience professional-grade wine preservation with the 30”W Integrated Wine Cellar. Designed for seamless integration and exceptional performance, this unit combines precision temperature control, quiet operation, and elegant design to keep up to 108 bottles perfectly stored and ready to enjoy. *CUSTOM PANEL & HANDLE SOLD SEPARATELY*

features.text: A proprietary, fully articulating hinge provides three-dimensional adjustability for perfect cabinet alignment, creating a flush, seamless built-in aesthetic with a soft-closing hinge damper for quiet, controlled movement.
Advanced electronic controls maintain temperatures within ±1°F across a wide range from 39 to 64 degrees, supporting ideal conditions for aging and serving every varietal in your collection.
Uniform air circulation works with enhanced humidity regulation to protect cork integrity, preserve aromatics, and maintain the nuanced character of each bottle throughout the cabinet.

Triple-pane bronzed glass shields from UV while maintaining stable interior conditions. Adjustable humidity settings preserve cork integrity, while dual active carbon filters prevent odors from compromising the wine’s character.

Twelve smooth-gliding wood-front shelves hold up to 72 bottles under refined LED lighting, while a stainless steel back wall adds durability and elegance. A quiet, low-vibration compressor keeps wines undisturbed for long-term aging.
A streamlined electronic interface makes adjusting temperatures and settings simple and precise, giving wine lovers confidence that each bottle is kept in ideal conditions and ready to enjoy.
